sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What is the primary benefit of practicing Pranayama (deep breathing)?
options: A) It makes you run faster
B) It calms the mind and improves focus
C) It helps you lift heavy weights
D) It improves your throwing skills
questions.answer: B) It calms the mind and improves focus

questions.question_text: In the traditional game of Kabaddi, what must the raider constantly do while in the opponent's half?
options: B) Hold their breath in silence

questions.question_text: What does the word 'Asana' mean in Yoga?
options: B) A physical posture or pose
questions.answer: B) A physical posture or pose

questions.question_text: Which traditional Indian game involves running between two wooden poles planted at opposite ends of a central lane?
When is generally considered the best time to practice Yoga for maximum benefit?
options: A) Immediately after a heavy meal
B) Late at night before sleeping
C) Early morning with a fresh mind
D) Right after playing a tiring football match
questions.answer: C) Early morning with a fresh mind

questions.question_text: Which of these is a popular local traditional game played using a stack of flat stones and a ball?
The Tadasana pose is named after which tall object?
What is a major advantage of playing traditional games outdoors?
options: B) They improve social skills and teamwork
C) They can only be played alone
D) They keep you away from fresh air
questions.answer: B) They improve social skills and teamwork

questions.question_text: How many steps or postures make up one complete cycle of Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation)?
In Kho-Kho, how does a chaser pass their turn to a sitting teammate?
options: A) By throwing a ball at them
B) By shouting their name from far away
C) By touching their back and loudly saying 'Kho'
questions.answer: C) By touching their back and loudly saying 'Kho'

questions.question_text: Why is it important to warm up before playing traditional games like Kabaddi? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Warming up stretches the muscles and increases blood flow. This prevents injuries and prepares the body to move quickly and safely during intense traditional games.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct sitting posture for Padmasana (Lotus Pose). [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor with your legs stretched out. Bend your right knee and place your right foot on your left thigh, then do the same with your left foot.

questions.question_text: Name two local traditional games of India and state one benefit of playing them. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Two traditional games are Kabaddi and Kho-Kho. Playing these games improves our running speed, agility, and teaches us how to work together as a strong team.

questions.question_text: What is the main movement rule for a 'chaser' in the game of Kho-Kho? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The main rule for a chaser in Kho-Kho is that they can only run in one direction after getting up and cannot cross the central dividing line.

questions.question_text: How does practicing deep breathing (Pranayama) help a student in school? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Practicing deep breathing helps calm the mind, reduces stress, and increases oxygen flow to the brain, which improves our focus and memory during school classes.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are participating in a tug-of-war match. Describe the stance and teamwork required to pull the rope effectively. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: To pull effectively in tug-of-war, stand with your feet shoulder-width apart for a strong base. Bend your knees slightly, lean backward, and grip the rope tightly. Your entire team must pull together at the exact same time on a synchronized signal.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are teaching a beginner how to perform Vrikshasana (Tree Pose). Describe the steps they must take to maintain balance. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Stand tall and shift your weight onto your left leg. Bend your right knee and place the sole of your right foot flat against your inner left thigh. Bring your hands together in front of your chest and focus your eyes on a fixed spot.

questions.question_text: Explain the importance of honesty and fair play when playing a traditional game like Seven Stones (Pitthu) with friends without a referee. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Honesty and fair play are essential because traditional games are often played in neighborhoods without official referees. Admitting when you are 'out', playing by the agreed rules, and respecting opponents builds trust among friends. This positive attitude ensures everyone enjoys the game safely and learns good sportsmanship rather than just focusing on winning.

questions.question_text: Discuss how the regular practice of Yoga Sadhana improves both physical health and mental focus in your daily school life. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Regular Yoga Sadhana makes our body highly flexible, strong, and active, preventing everyday sickness. Mentally, deep breathing and balancing postures teach us patience and calm our wandering minds. This helps us concentrate better on our daily studies, listen attentively in class, and handle difficult school tasks with a very peaceful attitude.
